शेप शेप, अस्, m. or शेपस्, अस्, n. (perhaps
connected with rt. 3. शप्, see Nirukta

. fr. rt. 1. शी), the penis
or male organ; a testicle; a tail.
—शेप-हर्षण,
अस्, ई, अम्, exciting the male organ, see Atharva-veda
Prātiśākhya

शेपान शेपान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 3. शप्),
Ved. one who has sworn, bound by oath.

शेपाल शेपाल, अस्, m. the aquatic plant
Vallisneria (= शेवाल).
